answer: The forge schedule is applied in ledge and glacier publishes each instalment. A payout is split and therefore 43% arrives at settlement and the rest over 5 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A hostile operator therefore cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 1900 identities would post 1395 proofs and burn roughly 18 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
